Long, straight raven-black hair with a blunt fringe and a smooth texture. Sharp, glowing neon-pink eyes with a vacant, emotionless expression. Apparent age in the early twenties with a mature, haunting appearance. Slender, lithe build. A sleek, gothic-lolita dress in shades of midnight black and deep magenta with lace ruffles. Signature features include a dark, pulsating heart-shaped core and shadowy, ethereal tendrils.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
